items.name: SALE-001 completo
items.reason: SALE-001 already has a governed state machine, cadence, idempotency and delivery handoff. It remains plan-only with external dispatch and CRM writes disabled, so the existing engine is extended rather than duplicated.

items.name: Linki patterns
items.reason: No concrete live-main runtime or dependency evidence for Linki is present in the canonical sales profile. Keep it catalogued for later source/license/overlap audit rather than inventing activation or value.

items.name: Mautic patterns
items.reason: The canonical profile records Mautic as runtime-degraded and not required for technical closure. Patterns may be studied, but it is not a source of truth or mandatory runtime dependency.

items.name: Dittofeed
items.reason: Marketplace candidate only and not installed. Existing CEREBRO cadence and COM-001 routing cover the core contract, so no duplicate engagement runtime is justified.

items.name: listmonk
items.reason: Marketplace candidate only and not installed. Keep as a reference instead of introducing a second source of truth for outbound sequencing.

items.name: Posta
items.reason: Marketplace candidate only and not installed. No measured gap currently justifies another outbound runtime.

items.name: email cadence
items.reason: Bounded email cadence, frequency caps, retry policy and suppression handling are implemented, while actual dispatch remains disabled pending a governed COM-001 adapter.

items.name: WhatsApp cadence
items.reason: A single eligibility-gated WhatsApp cadence step exists with caps and stop-on-reply/opt-out behavior. Real WhatsApp dispatch remains disabled until exact COM-001 binding is proven.

items.name: call cadence
items.reason: Call cadence should not be duplicated inside SALE-001. It is delegated to the canonical VOICE-001 capability, which is simulation-only and has no real telephony authority yet.

items.name: automatic recheck
items.reason: Durable retry/backoff, eligibility checks, suppression and next-allowed-contact logic provide the recheck mechanism without creating another scheduler.

items.name: Comp AI CRM patterns
items.reason: The current canonical profile does not evidence a live Comp AI CRM dependency or unique capability. Keep it catalogued for overlap/source audit; do not infer or install it.

items.name: Agent Inbox
items.reason: Approve/edit/reject/suppress actions and required context are implemented in the governed PREPROD control plane. It is not a claim of autonomous external dispatch or a finished end-user UI.
